description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'SugarRelationship' which manages relationships between modules in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for adding, removing, loading, and querying module relationships, as well as handling relationship metadata and related beans.

classes.name: SugarRelationship
classes.description: An abstract class representing a relationship between two modules in SuiteCRM, providing methods to manage and query relationships.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method to add a relationship between two beans.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a relationship between two beans.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Abstract method to load relationship data for a given link.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Abstract method to get the query used to load a relationship.

methods.name: getJoin
methods.description: Abstract method to get the join statement for relationship loading.

methods.name: relationship_exists
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a relationship exists between two beans.

methods.name: getRelationshipTable
methods.description: Abstract method to get the name of the relationship's database table.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all related beans associated with a link.

methods.name: removeById
methods.description: Removes a relationship row by its ID.

methods.name: getRHSModule
methods.description: Returns the name of the right-hand side module.

methods.name: getLHSModule
methods.description: Returns the name of the left-hand side module.

methods.name: getLHSLink
methods.description: Returns the left link in the relationship.

methods.name: getRHSLink
methods.description: Returns the right link in the relationship.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Gets the list of fields stored on the relationship.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to the relationship table or updates an existing one.

methods.name: updateRow
methods.description: Updates a specific row in the relationship table.

methods.name: removeRow
methods.description: Removes rows from the relationship table based on conditions.

methods.name: checkExisting
methods.description: Checks if a relationship row already exists for given data.

methods.name: getRoleWhere
methods.description: Constructs WHERE clause for role-based filtering.

methods.name: getCustomLogicArguments
methods.description: Prepares arguments for custom logic hooks.

methods.name: callBeforeAdd
methods.description: Triggers 'before_relationship_add' logic hook.

methods.name: callAfterAdd
methods.description: Triggers 'after_relationship_add' logic hook.

methods.name: callBeforeDelete
methods.description: Triggers 'before_relationship_delete' logic hook.

methods.name: callAfterDelete
methods.description: Triggers 'after_relationship_delete' logic hook.

methods.name: getOptionalWhereClause
methods.description: Generates optional WHERE clause based on criteria.

methods.name: addToResaveList
methods.description: Adds a bean to the list of beans to be resaved.

methods.name: resaveRelatedBeans
methods.description: Performs resaving of beans added to the resave list.

methods.name: isParentRelationship
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is a parent (flex/parent) relationship.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to retrieve relationship properties and default attributes.
